    (There might also be other ways to access this) (2:29)

  • Notes:
    Comes with a reversible cover and a 40-page liner notes booklet by Stephen Thrower, Calum Waddell and by Craig Lapper; also pages from the original "Nightmare Island" screenplay by Jay Slater, Posters, Lucio Fulci CV, and Notes on the Restoration.
    DVD title: Zombie Flesh Eaters (credits appear to be newly created and follow the Italian sequence).
    Mastered in 1080p from a 2K scan of the original 2-perf negative (revealing slightly more picture information than previous transfers from 4K intermediary materials, as well as a different color and contrast levels).
    First pressing will come with a poster reproduction (ZOMBIE FLESH EATERS on one side, and US poster for ZOMBIE on the reverse).

    - Gino De Rossi's Wall of Fame (2:06)

    OVERALL: Draw

    The R0 US 40th AE is features a 4K restoration and an exclusive featurette and an additional commentary.

    The R2 edition from Arrow Video is mastered from a 2K scan of the 2-perf Techniscope negative and has exclusive extras.

    The R0 US UE from Blue Underground features a new transfer, 6.1 DTS-ES track in both English and Italian, and the best set of extras.

    2-disc SE R1 from Media Blasters/Shriek Show also has a great selection of extras.

    R0 Holland has an isolated music track.

    R2 Scandinavia from Another World Entertainment also has DTS and a couple of substantial documentaries.

    R2 UK from Anchor Bay also has DTS tracks in both English and Italian with the "Box of the Banned" boxset having a couple of substantial documentaries. The set does have some cut films though.

    This film is also known as:
    - Island of the Flesh Eaters
    - Island of the Living Dead
    - Zombie 2: The Dead are Among Us
    - Zombie 2

  •  

    CUTS:

    • R0 America- Blue Underground - No cuts (91:12 NTSC)
    • R0 40th Anniversary Edition America- Blue Underground - No cuts (91:24 NTSC)
    • R0 The Lucio Fulci Collection America- Anchor Bay Entertainment - Yes - Missing a few seconds (91:00 NTSC):
      - Opening frames / music, the scene with the professor holding up his gun, the phone booth sequence with Al Cliver and the shark attack sequence is missing footage.
    • R0 Ultimate Edition America- Blue Underground - No cuts (91:12 NTSC)
    • R0 Germany- Dragon Entertainment - No cuts (87:32 PAL)
    • R0 Special Collector's Edition Holland- Italian Shock DVD Entertainment - No cuts (87:35 PAL)
    • R0 Korea- Seil DVD - Yes - Missing a few seconds (91:01 NTSC):
      - Opening frames / music, the scene with the professor holding up his gun, the phone booth sequence with Al Cliver and the shark attack sequence is missing footage.
    • R0 Extreme Version United Kingdom- Stonevision Entertainment - Yes - Cut by 0:23 by the BBFC, although 1:23 of previous cuts have been restored (87:31 PAL).
      The following has been cut:
      - At 44:00 shots of a splinter pushed through an eye.
      - At 59:00 shots of zombies feasting on human flesh.
    • R1 25th Anniversary Special Edition America- Media Blasters / Shriek Show - No cuts (91:15 NTSC)
    • R2 Japan- JVD - No cuts
    • R2 Scandinavia- Another World Entertainment - No cuts (91:20 NTSC-to-PAL)
    • R2 Box of the Banned United Kingdom- Anchor Bay Entertainment - No cuts (91:27 NTSC > PAL)
    • R2 Strong Uncut Version United Kingdom- Arrow Video - No cuts (87:30 PAL)
    • R4 Australia- Umbrella Entertainment - Yes - Missing a few seconds (91:07 NTSC > PAL):
      - Opening frames/music, the scene with the professor holding up his gun, the phone booth sequence with Al Cliver and the shark attack sequence is missing footage.
